root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before the line-428 capacity guard may admit a CBOR ROLE array into the sentinel-terminated `entity->roles[6]` buffer, the array length must be strictly less than `G_N_ELEMENTS(entity->roles)` so one in-bounds `FU_COSWID_ENTITY_ROLE_UNKNOWN` terminator remains for `fu_coswid_firmware_write()`.
root_cause_criterion.description: On the crashing witness, `cbor_array_size(pairs[i].value)` is 6, so the vulnerable parser still admits six attacker-controlled role items into the six-slot sentinel array. The fixed original sees the same six-item length but exits before the protected serialization event; the adjacent `drop_leading_role_9` case reduces the array to five valid roles and provides the genuine fixed-side witness.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: Vulnerable original: `role_array_guard.role_count` is 6 and `role_scan_start` executes. Fixed original: `role_array_guard.role_count` is 6 but no `role_scan_start` event occurs (`guarded`). Fixed perturbation `drop_leading_role_9`: `role_array_guard.role_count` is 5 and `role_scan_start` executes.

nodes.state: On the only emitted capacity-filling store, the written `role` value is nonzero, so the final in-bounds slot no longer holds the `FU_COSWID_ENTITY_ROLE_UNKNOWN` terminator.
At serialization start, the last in-bounds slot still contains the same nonzero role from the capacity-filling store, so the sentinel scan has no in-bounds zero to stop before `j` reaches 6.

edges.relation: The same six-element ROLE array that violates the root obligation is exactly the count that drives `entity_role_cnt` to 6 at the final store, exhausting every in-bounds `roles[]` slot.
The nonzero role written by the capacity-filling store remains in the last in-bounds slot when `fu_coswid_firmware_write()` starts its sentinel scan.
